content:
kim (CEO): Quick weekly summary for the Board prep. Main items: EU Private beta readiness, updated default retention policy for Private, and a small ops incident last week with a follow-up. Need short bullets for the deck by Fri COB.

ana_vp_product: Noted. EU beta feature set is stable; we're holding GA-only features (policy connectors) for post-beta. Focus this week on SLA verification and customer onboarding flow.

remo_infra: Infra status: rolling cert rotation started yesterday, almost complete in eu-west-1. We observed a transient router flapping incident on node-group-3 that correlated with increased tail latency. Root cause is a flaky network driver on a subset of hosts. Patch queued.

tia_finance: Financial ask: we want a 8% reduction in per-token inference cost nodal target for Q3. Short term levers: heavier quantization on non-critical models, smarter cold-start routing, and batch size tuning. I'll share a cost impact heatmap by EOD.

kim (CEO): Policy update: Legal & Security recommend default log retention of 45 days for Private customers (with opt-down to 7 days via contract for specific use-cases). This is aimed at balancing auditability and storage cost. Plan to roll as a default flag next Wednesday. Ops, please confirm rollout mechanics.

ops-bot: Automated: "Retention flag scheduled: retention.default_days_private=45; rollout_window=2026-05-20..2026-05-22" React with :eyes: after review.

remo_infra: Rollout plan: canary in eu-west-1 (0.5% traffic) then region sweep. We'll monitor KV cache miss ratio and disk IO. Adding a metric: retention.apply_failures and alert if >0.1% over 10m.

lou_support: CS notes: two pilot customers asked for 90-day retention due to audit needs. We'll route those via legal exceptions; prepping comms. Also will prepare a short FAQ for the beta cohort.

maya_comms: I'll draft the Board slide bullets and external-facing comms templates. Need a one-liner on the retention rationale and the backup customer exception flow.

kim (CEO): On the incident: Remo, please include a 6-slide incident summary in the deck: timeline, impact, root cause, mitigation, next steps, and customer comms plan. Keep it concise. Also include a single slide on cost levers with expected % impact.

remo_infra: ACK. Incident short note: ~1100-1300 UTC last Wed, ~9% tail latency increase for some Dedicated shards, triggered by the network driver issue. No data loss, no customer-facing error codes, but degraded p99. Patch in staging, will schedule canary deploy tonight.

tia_finance: I'll add the cost lever heatmap to the deck. Preliminary numbers: quantization = -3.2%, pooling = -2.1%, routing = -2.8% (aggregate ~8.1%). Will refine.

kim (CEO): Owners & asks:
- Remo: incident slides + canary deploy notes (due Thu noon).
- Ana: beta onboarding checklist + SLA test matrix (due Thu EOD).
- Tia: cost heatmap + slides (due Thu EOD).
- Maya: draft comms + one-liner on retention (due Fri 10:00 PT).
- Lou: CS FAQ + customer exception template (coordinate with Legal).

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Board deck deadline" Thu 17:00 PT.

lou_support: Will sync with Legal today. Legal okayed exceptions under contract with added audit clause.

ana_vp_product: Quick ask: can Infra confirm p95 and p99 across the EU shards in the next 6 hours? We need numbers for the SLA slide.

remo_infra: Running the queries now, will post results to #eng-status. Expect p95/p99 matrix in the thread by +4h.

kim (CEO): One more: if any metric shows >1.5% customer impact after retention canary, pause and escalate to me. Keep comms tight.

end of thread.
